why: Issue #930's second half: the stock pip's burst ring has NO `opacity: 0` in its own rule -- it rests invisible because `animation: ... both` holds a keyframe set opening at `opacity: 0`, which is why a population derived from base rules alone would miss it. Cancelling its animation under reduced motion deletes the ring instead of calming it. Retargeted by issue #1022, which deleted the `badge` arm this entry first guarded and left the ring as the only fill-held stock cue. Killed by the derived #631 rule and by the stock-loss cue block's own reduced-motion case.
